title: エリザベス女王杯の後に・らしくない

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although I did my best, I couldn't become queen… But I won't abandon my path to becoming a princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, I overhear some negative comments coming from the spectators. They say I lost because I'm not fit to be queen…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Were people really hurt because of my wild behavior?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What's more, it turns out that what Trainer was hiding from me before wasn't a present at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I guess Trainer was trying to keep me from seeing all these negative letters… Am I a princess that nobody wants?
